title: Discovery Flight Experience (Depart SKY Hangar)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
If you have never been in a helicopter before, this experience is for you! Discover the amazing world of helicopters, and enjoy a 20 min (50km loop) flight; tour the SKY Hangar, take a walk-around tour of the helicopter, wear full headsets while onboard to listen to the Airport Tower, local air traffic and of course your pilot! This is a perfect opportunity to fly in a helicopter with the kids, curious minds or treat yourself to the best gift in town!

SINGLE PASSENGERS: We require a minimum of TWO purchased seats of any flight in order to depart. Our team will do their best to pair you up with other passengers but if you are the only passenger booked on a departure, SKY reserves the right to cancel your booking.
